results.title: Yiwu, the world's largest wholesale market
results.content: Unknown to millions of people who nevertheless use products daily that have passed through its wholesale market, the Chinese city of Yiwu reached a business volume of 13.809 billion dollars in 2014, with exports to 219 countries. Moreover, the “Yixinou” train route connecting this city with Madrid has become the longest in the world, spanning 13,052 kilometers.

results.title: Yiwu Market Handbook: The Ultimate Shopping Companion | Global Sources
results.content:
Yiwu is world-renowned for its enormous wholesale market, which offers over 1.7 million products from around the globe. It's a great place to find unique items in bulk at low prices, with shorter lead times than traditional trade shows or platforms like Alibaba. However, it does not cater to niche markets as strongly and may be better suited for mass-market commodities such as toys, stationery, and consumer electronics.

Here are a few reasons why Yiwu Market has gained its reputation: [...] Yiwu Market primarily caters to non-Western buyers and showcases its diversity by including a specialized section for Islamic-approved products. The five districts are as follows:

### District 1

District 1 has four floors and a daily visitor flow of about 40,000, of which more than 5,000 are foreign buyers.

Product Highlights:

1st Floor: Flower accessories, artificial flowers, plush toys, electric toys, inflatable toys, plastic toys [...] 1. Diverse Product Range: Yiwu Market offers an extensive range of products across various categories, including accessories, textiles, toys, electronics, home goods, stationery, and much more. With over 75,000 individual shops and stalls spread across multiple specialized markets, buyers can find almost any type of small commodity they are looking for.
